title: Lunette operator profile
description: Who is talking to the agent: personal, never tracked. Read from ~/.agents/operator.{jsonc,yml} (every project) and from <main checkout>/.agents/local/operator.{jsonc,yml}, or ~/.agents/projects/<org>/<repo>/operator.{jsonc,yml} when the checkout has none (this project). The project profile wins key by key. What other people need (handle, role, ownership) also goes in the tracked team section of the project configuration.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

name.description: How the agent addresses the operator.

role.description: What the operator does in this project. Without a profile the agent assumes developer.

language.description: Language to talk in, as a BCP 47 tag (it, en). Records are written in the project's recording.language regardless.

confidence.description: How much the agent explains, per topic (git, ci, testing, databases, …). Level 1 = new to it, 5 = expert.

wantsToLearn.description: Explain the why, not only the how.

accounts.description: Accounts this operator uses for this project's services, by service (google, github, npm, …).

viewer.description: Where pages, diffs and questions are shown to the operator.

agents.description: Coding agents the operator uses, as named by `npx skills` (claude-code, codex, cursor, …).
